custody_model: Reviewed AscendEX materials describe exchange-hosted Earn positions. The Staking Agreement states that AscendEX stakes designated tokens through third-party validators, while the Yield Farming Agreement states that designated tokens may be deposited into relevant DeFi smart contracts. These product-specific mechanisms do not establish one universal segregated deposit, trust or legal-title model across AscendEX Earn.
yield_source: AscendEX describes multiple yield generators, including staking, DeFi yield farming, liquidity mining, lending and borrowing, plus promotional opportunities. Staking rewards may derive from validator activity and yield-farming positions may use DeFi smart contracts; no single yield source applies universally across all Earn products.
risk_notes: Risks include centralized-platform exposure, validator and unbonding risk, DeFi smart-contract risk, liquidity risk, variable or estimated returns, fixed-term lockups or redemption constraints, and digital-asset market risk. AscendEX states estimated staking yield is not guaranteed and its general risk disclosure warns of possible total loss.
